test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A-B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'Ax B' means 'A is the wife of B',

'A% B' means 'A is the father of B' and

'A # B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

How is E related to P if 'E % C # Q # L+ P'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74d0ce391ee26c9e1fbd76d603cc74b3853619c99ed8f7b23f50db35d7a97cde.png] 

**Given Code Language:**

 
 

 Symbol
 Meaning
 
 

 A + B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A - B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A x B
 A is the wife of B
 
 

 A % B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A # B
 A is the daughter of B
 
 

 

**Expression:**

**E % C # Q # L + P:** E is father of C. C is daughter of Q. Q is daughter of L. L is mother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/992d42a7661c52a43e645dd3f2f0e0d6931fb7978c98a0e5990dbfa46bfc07dc.png] 

Since Q is sister of P, E becomes **P’s sister’s husband**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4 — Sister's husband**.
